Account Director
Corpsumer PR

 

Department: Consumer PR & Influence 

Location: London 

Contract Type: Fixed-Term 12-Months

Full Time/Part time: Full Time 

Reporting into: Business Director / Client Partner 

 

The Role:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our team as an Account Director on a large technology account. You’ll spearhead high-impact PR campaigns and run a fast-paced press office that spans both consumer and corporate remits. 

You are a natural problem solver who thrives on challenge and builds instinctive, collaborative relationships across different agency Capabilities and Crafts. Combining a deep understanding of strategy with flawless execution, you will ensure the team constantly delivers creative, quality work that moves the needle for our client. 

 

About You:

  • 8+ years’ of PR experience, ideally with a “corpsumer” background  
  • A genuine interest in consumer tech and the evolving world of AI
  • Solid understanding of the UK media landscape and established journalist relationships 
  • A proven track record of managing fast-paced press offices and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects spanning consumer, corporate and policy remits 
  • Established as a trusted advisor to mid-level clients, with a strong grasp of their business context, challenges and goals 
  • A natural problem-solver who looks at briefs from unexpected angles and pushes for innovative ways to sell in and execute work 
  • Takes ownership of large projects and is accountable for both work and process 
  • An empowering mentor who guides junior team members, manages up effectively, and fosters a collaborative team culture 
  • Commercially astute, with experience managing budgets, scoping work, and resource planning to hit targets

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted partner and advisor
  • Lead and manage the fast-paced press office function, and projects across consumer, corporate and policy remits
  • End-to-end delivery of projects, from briefing, scoping and resourcing to execution and measurement, working with other Capabilities and Crafts instinctively
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including media, creators and internal client teams 
  • Oversee a team of Account Managers and Account Executives, providing guidance and mentorship, while also acting as an escalation point to support the team in resolving issues
  • Collaborate closely with integrated teams across Ogilvy, including social media and influencer marketing, to spot opportunities and align on campaigns and projects, where relevant 
  • Foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, and innovation within the agency and among the account management team
  • Serve as the main point of contact for mid-senior clients, managing communication and expectations throughout the project lifecycle
  • Ensure all campaign materials, including press releases and assets, are delivered to a high standard and align with the client's messaging and objectives
  • Lead regular client meetings and status updates to review project progress and discuss any changes or adjustments needed
  • Develop and implement measurement strategies, as required, to evaluate campaign effectiveness and report on ROI to clients
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and timelines
  • Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work 
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, ensuring a relevant and fresh approach 

 

How we help you Thrive: 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day  
  • Bupa Healthcare 
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave 
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm 
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure 
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year  
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme 
  • Life Assurance 

 

 

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Über Verve Retail Media

Das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende ist der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis. Marken investieren Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale, können aber nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe generiert wurden.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons und Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum stationären Kauf gehen: Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit einer AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen hinweg. Zudem haben wir Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billion ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr.

Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du gewinnst neue regionale Werbekunden für VRM am Telefon, qualifizierst warme Leads und buchst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives.

Was du tust

  • Telefonische Erstansprache regionaler Werbekunden auf Basis vorqualifizierter Leads
  • Bedarfs- und Entscheiderqualifizierung im Erstgespräch
  • Buchung qualifizierter Termine für die Account Executives im definierten Zielslot
  • Saubere Übergabe inkl. Pain Points, Kontext und Entscheidungsstruktur
  • Strukturierte Vorbereitung jedes Calls — Vorbereitung ist 80 % des Erfolgs

Dein Setup

  • Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Leads — nicht mit Cold-Listen
  • Salesforce als CRM, Aircall für die Telefonie, LLM-gestützte Recherche-Workflows
  • Klares Sales-Playbook mit Pitch-, Einwand- und Übergabe-Logik
  • Regelmäßige 1:1-Coachings, Call-Reviews und Pipeline-Calls

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigene Aktivitäts-Pipeline aufbauen, priorisieren und mit klaren KPIs (Calls/Tag, Termine/Tag, Show-Up-Rate) führen
  • Recherche zu Kunden, Branchen und Standorten als Grundlage jedes Calls
  • Pflege aller Aktivitäten und Opportunities in Salesforce
  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Account Executives: Feedback zur Termin-Qualität, gemeinsame Iteration
  • Aktives Mitwirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Pitches, Skripten und Workflows

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

  • Bericht direkt an den Head of Regional Sales
  • Du arbeitest im Team mit anderen SDRs sowie eng mit den Account Executives, an die du übergibst
  • Klare Karriereperspektive: Aufstieg zum Account Executive bei nachgewiesener Performance

Dein Profil

Diese Rolle ist bewusst auf Einsteiger und Quereinsteiger in den Sales zugeschnitten. Du passt, wenn du mindestens eines der folgenden Profile mitbringst:

  • Erste Sales-Erfahrung: Du hast in einer SDR-, BDR-, Inside-Sales-, Outbound-Call-Center- oder Telefonvertriebsrolle gearbeitet und willst auf das nächste Level.
  • Quereinstieg mit Telefonaffinität: Du kommst aus Kundenservice, Retail, Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder einem anderen Umfeld mit viel Kundenkontakt und willst gezielt in den Sales wechseln.

Für beide Profile gilt:

  • Du hast Spaß am Telefon, keine Scheu vor Erstansprache und kannst Menschen schnell für dich gewinnen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, bereitest dich vor und nimmst KPIs ernst
  • Du bist offen, coachable und willst täglich besser werden
  • Du nutzt LLMs aktiv für Recherche und Vorbereitung, oder bist bereit, das schnell zu lernen
  • Deutsch fließend auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (alle Calls auf Deutsch), Englisch von Vorteil
  • Du willst nicht für immer SDR bleiben, der Aufstieg zum Account Executive ist dein Ziel

Warum diese Rolle

Du steigst nicht in eine fertige Vertriebsmaschine ein. Du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf — und legst damit die Pipeline-Grundlage für unser komplettes Regional-Sales-Geschäft.

  • Echter Karrierepfad: Bei nachgewiesener Performance Aufstieg zum Account Executive in 12–18 Monaten
  • Warme Leads statt Cold-Calling-Liste
  • KI-gestützte Tools und Workflows, die deine Produktivität vervielfachen
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding und kontinuierliches Coaching
  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Fixum + transparente Termin-Vergütung + ungedeckelte Commission

Wenn du Sales lernen willst, wo es ernst gemeint ist und wo gute Leistung sichtbar wird, ist das die richtige Rolle.

Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As we continue to scale our Logistics business we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Executive to join our team in London, UK or New York, US. As an Account Executive at Altana Technologies, you'll be at the forefront of our sales initiatives, playing a crucial role in growing our footprint with Logistics Service Providers. You'll be working closely with various teams, including Account Management, Product Management, and Marketing to drive sales cycles and build new business pipelines.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed sales plans and sales forecasts
  • Drive active sales cycles while building new business pipeline through prospecting and relationship building with mid-sized Logistics Service Providers
  • Manage a large portfolio of Logistics Service Provider accounts from Ocean Liners to Customs Brokers.
  • Summarize product feedback gathered from customer meetings and act as advocate for our customers with internal development and product teams
  • Maintain up to date knowledge of logistics industry,
  • Ability to sell across multiple Lines of Business simultaneously (IT, Procurement, Transportation, Supply Chain/Logistics),
  • Travel to meet with clients, prospects and partners

About You

  • Experience working with a fast-growth technology company, strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of Enterprise Software sales experience is required
  • Passionate about the supply-chain and logistics/transportation space.
  • Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and executive audiences, whether it's an impromptu whiteboard discussion or a prepared presentation and demo.
  • Ability to be strategic, but still roll up your sleeves to accomplish what needs to be done
  • Highly organized with a strong sense of urgency to meet deadlines
  • Ability to operate in a rapidly-changing, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a cadence of delivering consistent results,
  • Track record of carrying and delivering against an annual quota of $1M+
  • Previous sales process & methodology training

This role is based in New York or the United Kingdom and candidates must be within commuting distance from our London office (UK) or New York office (US).

US Salary Range and Benefits

$100,000 - $155,000 USD

The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position.  The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  • Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Oﬀ (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.
  • Parental Leave: We oﬀer industry leading Paid Parental Leave (PPL), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.
  • Health Benefits: We have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. Our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA). There is also a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option.
  • Supplemental Benefits: Altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and AD&D insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.
  • 401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Fidelity 401(k) retirement savings program.
  • Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!
  • Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.
  • Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support.
  • Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre-tax funds for childcare expenses

The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Our Values

Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

  • Trust: Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
  • Resilience: In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
  • Stewardship: We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
  • Courage: Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

description: We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform. Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026. About the role As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built. We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it. What you’ll be doing Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow What we’re looking for Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier What to expect Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role. Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information. What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it. Why join Happl Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing Dental insurance, including family cover A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term About the Interview Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations) Stage 2: Short task Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops) Additional Details Location: London, Holborn Team: Finance Reports to: CEO Working arrangement: Hybrid (4+ Days in Office) #BS-L1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible. What You’ll Work On System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks. Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions. Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments. Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations. Ideal Candidate Profile: The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for. Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling. description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

 

 

ROLE SUMMARY 

 Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Engineer, Platform to own the platform Firmus engineers build and release on, in public cloud and in our own data centres. Self-service and security come first: through one golden path, an engineer should be able to create a service, get an environment, and ship to production securely with minimal support. Everything you design must work across sites and scale to hundreds of thousands of GPUs in gigawatt-scale AI factories. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Architecture and Decisions 

  • Own the architecture of the engineering platform and its multi-site management plane, in public cloud and on premises. Set a target architecture two to three years ahead and plan the steps from today's system to it. 
  • Design the platform around a repeatable scaling unit. Capacity grows in identical units, a failure stays inside one unit or site, and each site meets a defined standard before it carries the platform. 
  • Decide how internal Kubernetes and hypervisor clusters are built, networked, upgraded, and recovered. Keep Kubernetes conformant and close to upstream releases, with upgrades that need no downtime. New sites come up from code and the site deployment kit, and recovery is tested regularly. 
  • Decide how services are packaged, released, and promoted with progressive rollout, and how a failed release is rolled back and contained across sites. 
  • Lead design reviews for significant changes across the teams, sign off architecture decision records, and settle technical disputes escalated by engineers. Decide at pace with incomplete information, write down the assumptions, and revisit a decision when the evidence changes. 

 

 

Build and Evolve 

  • Own engineer self-service with an API-first design. The CLI, automation, and any developer portal all use the same platform API. Treat every ticket to the platform team as a gap in self-service and close the most common ones first. 
  • Keep a service catalogue in code, with an owner for every service and scorecards that show each team where its services stand against the golden path, production-readiness, and security standards. 
  • Provide multi-cluster deployment for internal teams and the customer product: one pipeline to every region and data centre, the customer product isolated from internal workloads, and sites that keep running when the orchestrator is unreachable. 
  • Let AI agents work on the delivery path under the same controls as engineers, with their own identity, least privilege, sandboxing, and a person approving every production change. 

 

 Reliability, security, and cost 

  • Set SLOs and error budgets for the platform and use the budget to decide when reliability work comes first. 
  • Lead the technical response to major incidents in the platform and make sure every post-mortem ends with a fix that stops it happening again. 
  • Set the standard every change meets before it goes live: code review, acceptance tests, builds traceable from source to deploy, and the application security team's controls in every pipeline by default. 
  • Provide secrets, certificates, and single sign-on as platform services, built to the security team's identity and secrets standard, with mutual TLS between services and credentials issued from code, short-lived, and rotated automatically. 
  • Build continuous compliance for SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the platform, with controls written as policy in code, evidence collected automatically, and drift detected and corrected. 
  • Automate patching without disruption and land urgent and embargoed security fixes within defined timelines. Nodes are replaced site by site from rebuilt images, within each service's disruption limits and with automatic rollback. 
  • Own cost at the design level, including cloud spend, with one shared path for every team and site. 

 

Technical leadership 

  • Grow engineers through mentorship, design review, and code review. Hiring and performance review sit with the Engineering Manager. 
  • Set how the team uses AI to build software effectively and securely, with review gates and automated architecture checks that keep AI-generated code within the agreed design. 
  • Own the technical interviews and assessments for platform engineers and hold every candidate to that bar. 

 

Partnership and communication 

  • Shape the platform roadmap with product, infrastructure, network, and site-delivery leaders, and have the platform ready before each new region or data centre goes live. 
  • Agree ownership in writing at each boundary with infrastructure, network, security, software, data and observability, and settle disagreements directly. 
  • Represent the platform team in customer and auditor reviews of security, reliability, and compliance. 

 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 10+ years in platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including at least 3 years at principal level or equivalent, setting the technical direction that multiple teams delivered against. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way. 
  • Has owned a golden path other engineers used to ship: infrastructure as code (such as Terraform or OpenTofu), CI/CD, and GitOps (such as Argo CD or Flux), with progressive rollout, rollback, artifact signing and provenance, and security gates in the pipeline. 
  • Has run a platform as a product, with self-service through templates and a platform API or CLI that teams adopted, measured by adoption and delivery performance rather than uptime alone. 
  • Has built, upgraded, and recovered Kubernetes on self-managed servers, including on virtualised infrastructure, as well as in a public cloud such as AWS, across more than one site. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Kubernetes internals: the API server and etcd, scheduling, networking (such as Cilium, with mutual TLS), storage, and admission control. 
  • Strong in Go or Python, with services, controllers, or tools other teams consume, not only infrastructure code. 
  • Has built security into a platform: secrets management (such as Vault or OpenBao), certificate automation, short-lived credentials, and fleet patching with no visible impact on services, under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent control set. 
  • Has run a reliability programme other engineers followed: SLOs and error budgets, change control, and incident reviews that changed the system. 
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, able to explain problems, decisions, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and customers. 
  • Willing to join the on-call rotation for the services you own and to travel overseas occasionally. 

 

Location & Reporting

  •  Location: we are open to offer capable candidates to be based in either Australia or Singapore
  • Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering

 

Employment Basis

Full-time

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

description: Bij Salland Engineering zoeken we een Product Engineer die een belangrijke rol speelt in het goed functioneren van onze pilot line en in de ondersteuning van het productieteam. In deze functie ben je de verbindende schakel tussen productie, engineering en klant. Het team Product Engineering, onderdeel van de Semitest Group, wordt steeds belangrijker binnen Salland Engineering. Binnen deze omgeving ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vrijgeven van testoplossingen voor kwalificatie, karakterisatie en productie test. Daarnaast begeleid je kwalificatieruns in samenwerking met de klant, de planner en onze reliability partner. Je werkt continu aan verbeteringen en streeft samen met je team naar efficiëntere processen en tooling. Storingen zie je niet als obstakel, maar als uitdaging. Je schakelt snel, denkt analytisch én praktisch en zorgt ervoor dat we optimaal blijven presteren. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer en hebt veel contact met operators, teamleiders, engineeringcollega’s en de planner. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden Je begeleidt nieuwe productintroducties (NPI) in productieomgevingen; Je beheert en evalueert kwalificatie- en betrouwbaarheidstesten, zoals HTOL, HAST en Temp Cycle; Je analyseert testdata om prestaties, yield en betrouwbaarheid te beoordelen; Je troubleshoot op device-, hardware- en softwareniveau en voert root cause analyses uit bij testafwijkingen, yield drops en product failures; Je verleent technische ondersteuning aan productie- en testteams bij productissues en analyseert en lost device-, test- en procesafwijkingen op; Je borgt soepele overgangen naar high volume manufacturing (HVM); Je treedt op als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stemt technische verbeteringen af met leveranciers en externe testpartners; Je coördineert technische projecten gericht op testoptimalisatie, yieldverbetering en productinnovatie en stelt product release reports, karakterisatieverslagen en yieldanalyses op. Waar ga je werken Aangenaam, wij zijn Salland Engineering uit Zwolle! Al meer dan 30 jaar ontwikkelen wij oplossingen en leveren wij diensten voor het testen van chips. Onze technologie vind je terug in alledaagse producten zoals smartphones, tablets en auto's. Samen met zo’n 95 collega’s werken we dagelijks aan innovatieve projecten en bedienen we 's werelds grootste fabrikanten van chips en meetinstrumenten. Wat krijg je van ons Een uitdagende baan in een hightech-omgeving. We waarderen het nemen van initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid dragen, maar er is meer! Wij bieden: Een aantrekkelijk salaris (afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring) tussen de € 3.410,57 en € 4.872,23 bruto per maand (functieschaal: Engineer Expert A) bij een 40-urige werkweek; Een omgeving waarin ontwikkeling centraal staat. Daarom krijg je als medewerker bij Salland Engineering alle ruimte, mogelijkheden en vrijheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zo groeien we samen! description: Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht. Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen. Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht. Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll. Was du bei uns machst Probleme wirklich verstehen: Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen. Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren: Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung. Die Produktrichtung gestalten: Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung. Lösungen konkret machen: Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst. Korrektheit sicherstellen: Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen. Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben: Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen. Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur. Was du mitbringst Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis: Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll. Produktdenken: Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe. Analytische Stärke: Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt. Technische Neugier: Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren. Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert. Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus. Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken. Du ergänzt ein starkes Team: Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten. Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten: Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen. Du baust langfristig mit: Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage. Deine Benefits Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro. Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget. Sport: 50 € Fitnesszuschuss. Weiterentwicklung: 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr. Lesestoff: Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir. Du verstehst Buchhaltung und hast konkrete Ideen, wie Software sie besser machen kann? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Verstehe, wie Menschen arbeiten. Bau die Software, die ihre Arbeit besser macht. Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Wir können direkt beobachten, wo Prozesse haken, welche Informationen fehlen und was Menschen unnötig Zeit kostet. Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen. Was du bei uns machst Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen: Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen. Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen: Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen. Die Roadmap gestalten: Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich. Lösungen entwickeln: Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design. Zusammenhänge durchdringen: Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind – und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben. Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt. KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe: Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss. Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten: Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss. Gutes Produkturteil: Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe. Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme: Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen. Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz: Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus. Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit: Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung. Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise: Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran. Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein – wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe. Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest Du bist nah am Problem: Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit: In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen. Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag: Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team: Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. Deine Benefits Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro. Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget. Sport: 50 € Fitnesszuschuss. Weiterentwicklung: 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr. Lesestoff: Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir. description: About Weezevent From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats. We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control, CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world. Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year. Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy). Key Responsibilities: Product Vision and Strategy: execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands. Stakeholder Collaboration: act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features. Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation. Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members. Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company. Product Backlog Management: create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements. Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team. Development and Delivery: work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines. Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value. Market and User Research: analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology. Compliance and Risk Management: ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements. Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence. Performance Monitoring: monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators. Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback. Why it's a good move ? You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance. Fundamentals to join us : You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ; You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory. You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle. You speak French fluently. Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk ! All of our positions are open to people with disabilities. Compensation and benefits We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues. A company laptop is provided from your first day. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

  • Lead and/or assist in internal team projects including customer environment replication for bug investigations, integrations with new third-party tools, and development of automations both for customer use-cases as well as internal team processes

  • GitHub
  • NGINX
  • SQL

  • DNS
  • HTTP

  • SAML and OpenID Connect
  • TLS/SSL and PKI

The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients. Why this role matters An inspection delivers a list of findings. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.
  • Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.
  • Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.
  • Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.
  • Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.
  • Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.
  • Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.
  • Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.
  • Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.
  • Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.
  • The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.
  • Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.
  • Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.
  • Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

description: MILLeRH Conseil recrute, pour le compte d'un cabinet médical spécialisé installé au sein d'une clinique toulousaine, un(e) secrétaire médical(e) à temps complet. Le secrétariat occupe une place essentielle dans le fonctionnement du cabinet : premier et dernier interlocuteur du patient, il contribue directement à la qualité de son accueil et de son parcours de soins. Dans un environnement dynamique, où les sollicitations sont nombreuses, nous recherchons une personne à l'aise dans la relation avec les patients, organisée, réactive et capable de gérer les priorités avec autonomie. Vos missions Au quotidien, vous aurez notamment pour missions de : assurer l'accueil physique et téléphonique des patients et leur orientation ; gérer les agendas, la prise de rendez-vous et les flux d'activité ; créer, mettre à jour et assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers médicaux ; assurer la facturation des consultations et actes médicaux ainsi que les encaissements ; préparer et suivre les documents nécessaires au parcours de soins ; récupérer et intégrer les résultats d'examens dans les dossiers patients ; assurer la frappe et la mise en forme de courriers et comptes rendus médicaux ; organiser les bureaux et préparer les éléments nécessaires aux consultations ; assurer le suivi des stocks et les commandes de consommables et de matériel médical. L'ensemble de ces missions est exercé dans le respect strict de la confidentialité, du secret professionnel et de l'identitovigilance. Vos compétences Une expérience préalable de l'environnement médical est indispensable pour ce poste. Votre candidature pourra être étudiée si vous correspondez à l'un des deux profils suivants : secrétaire médical(e) disposant d'au moins 1 an d'expérience professionnelle en secrétariat médical, idéalement en cabinet, clinique ou établissement de santé ; OU aide-soignant(e) ayant exercé en milieu hospitalier, dans le cadre d'un projet de reconversion professionnelle vers le secrétariat médical. Au-delà de cette expérience, le poste nécessite : un excellent sens de l'accueil et de la relation avec les patients ; une bonne expression orale et écrite ; une réelle aisance avec les outils informatiques ; rigueur, organisation et capacité à prioriser ; autonomie et capacité à travailler en équipe ; discrétion et respect absolu de la confidentialité ; capacité à conserver qualité d'accueil et efficacité lorsque l'activité est soutenue. Les candidatures ne répondant à aucun des deux profils d'expérience précisés ci-dessus ne pourront pas être retenues. Avantages L'organisation du poste permet de travailler au sein d'une équipe structurée, dans un environnement médical stimulant et au contact quotidien des patients et des professionnels de santé. Conditions de travail : temps complet de 39 heures par semaine ; travail sur 5 jours, du lundi au vendredi ; horaires alternés matin/après-midi, sur une amplitude comprise entre 8h00 au plus tôt et 19H30 au plus tard ; pause déjeuner de 30 minutes rémunérée ; Rémunération 2 245 € brut mensuels, prime 13e mois, déjeuner pris en charge. Chez MILLeRH Conseil, nous considérons qu'un recrutement réussi repose autant sur les compétences que sur la capacité d'une personne à trouver sa place dans son futur environnement professionnel. Les candidats présélectionnés seront invités à réaliser des tests professionnels en ligne, portant sur certaines compétences directement nécessaires à l'exercice du poste. Les candidats retenus à l'issue de cette étape seront ensuite reçus en entretien par MILLeRH Conseil avant présentation de leur candidature au cabinet médical. Si vous vous reconnaissez dans le profil recherché et souhaitez rejoindre durablement une équipe médicale exigeante et investie, nous vous invitons à nous transmettre votre candidature. THE PROJECT 📝 

We're looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join Form3 on a 12 month fixed term contract basis to deliver a strategic programme of security enhancements across our cloud-native payments platform. 

Focusing on improving cloud security, operational resilience and governance across our engineering ecosystem, you will work closely with our Platform Engineering and Security teams to design and implement practical security improvements that enhance how we build, deploy and operate critical payment infrastructure. 

You'll play a key role in strengthening areas such as cloud platform security, software supply chain security, identity and access management, AI governance, cryptographic controls and automated security assurance, ensuring solutions are scalable, production-ready and aligned with regulatory expectations. 

Key responsibilities 

  • Assess the current cloud security posture across Form3 environments, identifying risks, control gaps and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls that improve the resilience and security of our cloud-native platform. 
  • Enhance perimeter security controls across cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strengthen CI/CD pipeline security through secure build processes, automated security testing, deployment governance and artefact integrity. 
  • Improve production access security, including RBAC, least-privilege implementation, deployment tooling and operational processes. 
  • Enhance software supply chain security through dependency management, container image scanning, provenance, signing and vulnerability remediation. 
  • Contribute to the secure adoption and governance of AI-enabled engineering capabilities, including controls for data protection, auditability and operational resilience. 
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud security architecture and secure engineering practices. 
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures and security evidence. 
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, platform and security teams to deliver maintainable, production-ready security improvements. 
  • Ensure all deliverables align with operational resilience requirements, regulatory obligations and internal security standards. 
  • Deliver changes using structured, low-risk change management practices while maintaining service availability. 

 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 

Essential 

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing cloud security solutions within large-scale cloud-native environments. 
  • Strong hands-on experience securing public cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture, identity and access management, workload protection and infrastructure security. 
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. 
  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including dependency management, artefact signing, provenance and vulnerability management. 
  • Experience implementing least-privilege access models and RBAC. 
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, risk assessment and security governance. 
  • Experience working within highly regulated or business-critical production environments. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams. 
  • Strong technical documentation and design skills. 

 

Desirable 

  • Experience implementing security controls for AI or machine learning platforms. 
  • Knowledge of cryptographic controls and key management. 
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code tooling. 
  • Familiarity with payment platforms or financial services environments. 
  • Understanding of operational resilience frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting critical financial infrastructure. 
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP or similar). 

 

TECH STACK ⚙️ 

  • AWS – Cloud infrastructure and security controls. 
  • Kubernetes – Container orchestration and workload security. 
  • Terraform – Infrastructure as Code and security automation. 
  • CI/CD tooling – Secure software delivery, build security and deployment governance. 
  • Container security tooling – Image scanning, vulnerability management and runtime protection. 
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) – Least privilege, RBAC and privileged access controls. 
  • Software Supply Chain Security – Dependency scanning, artefact signing, provenance and integrity controls. 
  • Security monitoring & observability platforms – Detection, auditability and operational visibility. 
  • AI governance and security controls – Supporting secure adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities. 

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

Stage 2: Cloud Security & Engineering Best Practices interview

description: London – Senior Consultant, Strategy & Data Science in Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) Ekimetrics UK Job Description Ekimetrics is a leader in data science and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve pioneered the use of AI and data science applied to unified marketing measurement and holistic business optimization aligned with sustainability performance. Our goal: Combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for sustainable business performance. At Ekimetrics, we have the ambition to help our clients rethink their business models by reconciling economic, environmental and social performance through data science. 📊Key figures about Ekimetrics · 400 data science experts globally (50+ in the UK) · 1000 diverse projects for more than 350 clients · 4 offices: Paris, Hong Kong, London and New York · $1 billion in profits generated for our clients since 2006. · 7000 tons of CO2 prevented by our clients in 2022. · UK data company of the year 2023 · Voted Great Place to Work 2023 · Microsoft’s sustainability partner · Voted as a leader in “Marketing Measurement and Optimization” by Forrester wave 2023 Why are we hiring? As we continue to grow, bringing on new global clients, we are looking for a manager to join our London office. We want to strengthen our market optimization offering which focuses on “Marketing Effectiveness” and “Marketing Measurement”. We support clients with detailed recommendations that can be acted upon immediately, as well as on longer-term brand strategies, reconnecting immediate and future business impact. Your role in the team As a Senior Consultant, you will be expected to work in various teams to service global clients, on key accounts, across multiple continents to deliver marketing and customer analytics projects that will lead to significant, value-led transformations. You will support Managers by acting as project lead for our clients. You will gain a deep understanding of their needs and offer the most effective solutions, providing impactful and useful insights to help steer their revenue or data strategies, and building long-term relationships. Embedded in the core of this position lies your expertise in Marketing Mix Modelling. You will be responsible for steering the client, and delivery of BMC's and MMM models. Whilst you may not generate these models directly you will need prior knowledge of MMM and modelling platforms. Your role will require you to navigate these insights into compelling stories that resonate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Overview · Use your knowledge and experience In Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) to make business-led decisions · Create real valuable actionable insights for clients defining their marketing and strategic direction. · Lead projects with globally recognised brands · Manage and lead end-to-end analytics projects, including planning, design, and implementation. · Lead a team of 3-8 consultants. About You We are looking for someone who can show both advanced analytics skills and a strong interest in marketing & business strategy. Ideally, you’ll have: · Strong Knowledge and experience in Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) · Experience working across large data sets · Understanding of media variables/econometrics and prior modelling experience. · Experience working with clients and account management · Knowledge and/or understanding of Coding languages such as Python or R - we use Python at Eki · Proficiency in Microsoft Office software such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel · Degree in Economics/Econometrics, Maths/Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Science or a related field · Interest in working in a fast-paced and driven consultancy environment. · Clear and concise communication Working for Eki Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! We have clients across multiple industries and are constantly looking to innovate and explore new ways of doing things. Our London team consists of ~50 people and are predominantly Data Science Consultants. We come from all over the world, have varied experiences and passions, and all contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success. We encourage continuous self-development and thought leadership throughout Ekimetrics and foster a culture of transmission and pleasure – we love what we do, and we want to share it! As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following: · Hybrid working (2 days a week in the office) · 25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays and additional days for tenure) · Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services (all on entry) · Regular socials and events · Group pension scheme · An emphasis on work-life-balance and a strong company culture · Eki.Anniversary gifts for every year of service · Opportunities to develop a dual profile in data science and strategic consulting. · Unique training programs and learning opportunities. · Opportunities for international mobility Our recruitment process 🔸 HR intro interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist/Recruiter 🔸 Interview with a Senior Consultant or Manager - Technical discussion and overview of Ekimetrics 🔸 Case study interview with a Manager+ 🔸 Final interview with a Senior Manager/Partner We would be delighted to provide you with further information during an interview and look forward to receiving your application! Any questions please contact __________________________________________________________________________________ At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people - they are what set us apart and drive our success. We encourage entrepreneurial spirit and innovation. We share what we know with others, and, above all, we love what we do. These sentiments are supported by our company values which serve as pillars in our work and attitude. Follow our Ekimetrics’ values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission and Pleasure. Ekimetrics is an equal opportunities employer committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, creed, religion, nationality, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military veteran status, current employment status, or any other legally protected categories, subject to applicable law. description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME) Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk Vakantiegeld 8% CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00 Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities Wat ga je doen: Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel) Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen. Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem. Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000 Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA) Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal) In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken? Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst. We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt. Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent. Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken. 👉 Is deze functie perfect voor jou?
